title: Temporary Dexterity
description: Gain [gold]Dexterity[/gold] until the end of this turn.
smart_description: Gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] until the end of this turn.
notes: Abstract base class representing a temporary Dexterity buff lasting until the end of the current turn. The displayed title is derived from the OriginModel (card, potion, or relic) that applies it. When applied, internally triggers a DexterityPower to grant the actual +Dexterity. At end of turn, the power is removed and a negative DexterityPower is applied to undo the buff. Stack type Counter allows multiple stacks to coexist. Can be inverted to debuff (negative Dexterity) by setting IsPositive to false.
